data.name: Natwar
data.gender_notes: Natwar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Natwar is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Nath', meaning 'Lord'. The suffix 'War' means 'Wealth'. The name signifies the Lord of Wealth. The name Natwar carries the meaning “Lord of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Natwar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Natwar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Natwar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
